data.gender_notes: Eusebia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word eu ('good') and sebomai ('to reverence, to worship'). The name Eusebia signifies a person who is well-disposed towards God. The name Eusebia carries the meaning “God's goodwill, well-disposed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eusebia usually hope their child will grow to embody god's goodwill, well-disposed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eusebia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's goodwill, well-disposed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eusebia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אוסביה
in_hebrew.meaning: אוסביה - שם נוצרי שמשמעותו 'יראת אלוהים' או 'אדוקת אלוהים'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוסביה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'יראת אלוהים' או 'אדוקת אלוהים'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'εὐσεβής' (eusebēs), שפירושה 'יראת אלוהים' או 'אדוקת אלוהים'. השם היה בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים הראשונים והוא נמצא גם בכתבי הקדושים של הכנסייה הנוצרית. השם אוסביה משקף את הערכים הנוצריים של יראת אלוהים וציות לרצונו.

in_greek.name: Εὐσεβία
in_greek.meaning: Εὐσεβία - σημαίνει 'ευσέβεια' δηλαδή σεβασμός προς τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εὐσεβία προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'εὐσεβής' (eusebēs), που σημαίνει 'ευσέβεια' δηλαδή σεβασμός προς τον Θεό. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η λέξη 'εὐσεβής' χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει εκείνους που έχουν σεβασμό και φόβο για τον Θεό. Το όνομα Εὐσεβία ήταν κοινό ανάμεσα στους πρώτους Χριστιανούς και αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία της ευσεβείας και του σεβασμού προς τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Eusebia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eusebia origine Graeco derivatum est et significat 'pietas' seu 'timor Dei'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Eusebia usitatum erat inter fideles et reflectit valores Christianos pietatis et obedientiae voluntati Dei. Etymologia nominis Eusebia ex Graeca voce 'εὐσεβής' (eusebēs) provenit, quae 'pietatem' seu 'timorem Dei' designat.

in_english.name: Eusebia
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Eusebia originates from the Greek word 'εὐσεβής' (eusebēs), meaning 'pious' or 'God-fearing'. It reflects the Christian values of piety, reverence, and obedience to God's will. Historically, the name Eusebia was used among early Christians and is found in the writings of the Church Fathers. The name symbolizes a deep sense of spirituality, devotion, and commitment to Christian principles. Eusebia is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, compassion, and humility.

historical_references.reference: Eusebia was a daughter of Emperor Constantine the Great and Faith, his second wife. She was a devout Christian and is traditionally regarded as the first Christian empress of the Eastern Roman Empire. She was born around 320 AD and died in 378 AD, during the reign of her brother Constantius II.

Eusebia was also a name of several early Christian saints and martyrs, including a virgin and martyr who suffered during the persecution of Diocletian in the late 3rd century AD. She is venerated as a saint in the Eastern Orthodox, Roman Catholic, and Anglican Churches.
